descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S17 「两条路进来，一个列表：被邀请的和自己注册的医生，不管邮箱大小写每人一条记录，他们的「added」和「first signed in」日期，以及他们的接受记录」 Two ways in, one list: invited and signed-up physicians, one record per person whatever the email case, their 'added' and 'first signed in' dates, and their acceptances

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 Open sign-up: a new email that was never invited signs in with the emailed code. The physician is created and appears in the physician list.（UAT OAT-01 step 6；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 13） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U8 Invite: a physician whose email was added in Convex in advance signs in with the emailed code and gets the same flow, including the agreements screen. …（UAT OAT-01 step 8；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 13；TFA-94700 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U10 Each physician's record, invited or signed up, shows the date they were added (invite or sign-up) and the date they first signed in.（UAT OAT-01 step 10；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 19） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U11 The agreement acceptance is saved with the physician, a timestamp, the document version and both checkbox acceptances.（UAT OAT-01 step 10；TFA-94700 AC 10；TFA-94700 AC 11）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The deployed QA build. Physician P-inv invited in Convex at T0 who first signs in at T1 and again at T3. Physician P-up who signs up at T2. One device with its clock set a day wrong (UAT 3.8).

When Each signs in with the emailed code and accepts the agreements screen. Then read the physician list and both acceptance rows. Case cells: invite an address typed with capitals (e.g. invited as Dr.X@Clinic.org), then sign in as dr.x@clinic.org; sign up first, then get invited with the same address; …

Then Both see the same agreements screen. Both appear in the same physician list. P-inv: added = T0, first signed in = T1 (unchanged by T3). P-up: added = T2 (per Q5), first signed in = T2. All dates use server time, whatever the device clock says. Each has an acceptance row with timestamp, document version and both boxes. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U8 (same flow, same list), U10 (dates, Q5 for their meaning, Q4 for where the list is), U11 (acceptance row), U6 / risk 'one person, two records', UAT 3.8 (server clock). A missing date, a date in device time, or two list entries for one physician = Fail. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
